Pulsa Ctrl + K (o la barra de arriba) y: Press Ctrl + K (or use the bar at the top) and search for tasks, classes, channels, songs, notes and even words inside your PDFs. It also does math: type 25*4 and it gives you the result.

En Configuración eliges el tema, el colo: In Settings you choose the theme, the color, notifications and more. Everything is stored only on this computer.
Aquí ves juntos los videos nuevos de los: Here you see the new videos from the YouTube channels you follow, all together and with no ads in between. The most recent come first.
Usa «Agregar canal» (arriba a la derecha: Use “Add channel” (top right) and paste the link to a YouTube channel or playlist. Drag channels to reorder them and tap one to see only its videos.
Al abrir un video se reproduce dentro de: When you open a video it plays inside Nexo. You can change the speed, save it to favorites and queue videos to watch one after another. Nexo remembers where you left off.
El buscador de arriba (Ctrl + K) también: The search bar at the top (Ctrl + K) also finds videos and channels by title.
Escucha música sin salir de Nexo. Puedes: Listen to music without leaving Nexo. You can use it as a guest or connect your Spotify account to get your playlists and save songs.

Marca canciones con el corazón para guar: Mark songs with the heart to save them. With Spotify connected you'll also see “Liked Songs”, your playlists, your artists and your albums.
La barra de abajo tiene los controles. Á: The bar at the bottom has the controls. Open it full size to see the synced lyrics, and set the timer if you want the music to stop by itself when you fall asleep.
Si una función pide un permiso nuevo (se: If a feature asks for a new permission (following artists, editing playlists), Nexo explains it and brings you back to the same place. It's only once.
Convierte y edita PDF, Word, Excel y Pow: Convert and edit PDF, Word, Excel and PowerPoint. Nothing is uploaded to the internet: everything happens on your own computer.
Suelta tus archivos en la zona punteada: Drop your files in the dotted area (or paste them with Ctrl + V) and choose the tool: convert, merge, split, compress, rotate, watermark, number pages, recognize text (OCR)…

Arriba está «Mis tareas»: una carpeta po: At the top is “My assignments”: one folder per subject to save and open your work. From there you can also create a new Word, Excel or PowerPoint file.
Suelta el archivo aquí o elígelo desde t: Drop the file here or pick it from your computer. If you already had it in the Documents queue, it shows up on its own.
Cada herramienta tiene sus opciones (cal: Each tool has its own options (quality, pages, text…). The default values are usually fine.
Pulsa el botón principal, espera a que t: Press the main button, wait for it to finish and download the result. Afterwards you can open the folder where it was saved.

Entra a una carpeta y arrastra tus archi: Open a folder and drag your files in, or use “Add files”. “New file” creates a blank Word, Excel, PowerPoint or text file right there.
Toca un archivo para abrirlo con su prog: Tap a file to open it with its app. With the buttons on the right you rename or delete it; a folder can only be deleted if it is empty.
Con Ctrl + K puedes buscar una palabra d: With Ctrl + K you can search for a word inside your subjects' PDFs and open them right on that page.
Tareas, exámenes, citas y cumpleaños de: Tasks, exams, appointments and your friends' birthdays, each with its own color.
Usa «Añadir tarea o evento» para crear u: Use “Add task or event” to create one, with a time and even repeating every week or month. “Add birthday” saves your friends' birthdays.
Nexo te avisa con una notificación de Wi: Nexo notifies you with a Windows notification. Choose when to be notified from the notifications panel.
Cambia entre la vista de mes y la de sem: Switch between the month and week views. Quick notes hold loose to-dos that have no date.

Con tu horario, Nexo puede crear las car: With your schedule, Nexo can create your subjects' folders in My assignments so you can keep your work there.
